scripts.verify-dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function scan(d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())scan(p);else if(/\.(csv|tsv|xlsx|zip)$/i.test(f)){console.error('SECURITY BLOCK: Data file found in build output:',p);process.exit(1);}}}scan('dist');console.log('Security check passed: zero data files in dist/');"
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run verify-dist
